title: Alien Over Ruined World
description: A tall, emaciated grey alien with large black eyes and exposed ribcage stands in the foreground of a desolate landscape. Behind it, ancient stone ruins sit under a cosmic sky featuring a large purple moon, multiple black celestial bodies in eclipse alignment, and a vibrant magenta nebula.
